description: The file declares utility functions for managing and terminating Cuttlefish instances, including stopping all instances, forcefully stopping a process group, and killing the CVD server process.

methods.name: KillAllCuttlefishInstances
methods.description: Runs stop_cvd for all Cuttlefish instances and sends SIGKILL to their processes.

methods.name: ForcefullyStopGroup
methods.description: Forcefully stops all processes belonging to a specified user ID group.
